findings.mechanism: Static access-ordered LinkedHashMap of orders keyed by id; looks like an unbounded cache that grows with every order.
findings.cause: Bounded: removeEldestEntry evicts once size() > CAPACITY (1000), so entries and their Order/notes strings are released.
findings.evidence: Ran shop.Main with 400000 requests (-Xmx256m, System.gc() at each checkpoint): cached orders stayed at 1000 and heap in use was flat (2323 KB, 2035, 2034, 2034 KB) while 350000 distinct orders were placed.
findings.discriminator: Cache size plateaus at exactly 1000 and post-GC heap is flat across 4 checkpoints over 400k requests; eviction hook caps the map.
